name: Caribbean Pleasure
notes: Own site (caribbeanrestaurantsandiego.com) has no prices anywhere - just dish names/descriptions on Food/Desserts/Drinks pages. Found the restaurant's own FOX Ordering / FromTheRestaurant storefront via search, address and phone match exactly (3334 Rosecrans St, San Diego CA 92110, (619) 782-9263). Read all 5 categories: Entree (7), BBQ (2), Kids Menu (2), Sides (6), Drinks (5) = 22 items, matching the page's own per-category counts. Cent endings are scattered (.10/.15/.20/.25/.30/.35/.50/.75/.90/.95/.00); ran the divisor sweep 1.00-1.35, nothing lands >=50% round, so not a uniform markup. Subtraction test: BBQ Beef Short Ribs $25.10 vs BBQ Pork Ribs $27.20 = $2.10, and Haitian Fried Chicken* $20.90 vs Haitian Jerk Chicken $23.00 = $2.10 - same difference twice, real pricing not a computed field. Several items share flat tier prices across categories ($6.20 for three juices, $8.30 for three sides/drink, $9.35 for two sides) which reads as deliberate menu-tier pricing, not corruption.

name: Urban Location Boba Tea House San Diego
notes: Restaurant's own Wix site (urbanlocationteahouse.com or similar) has no menu page; its /hours-location page links each of its 4 franchise locations to its own Square Online ordering storefront, San Diego's being urbanlocationsandiego.square.site - treated as the first-party ordering platform for this location, not a third-party marketplace. This is a client-rendered Square Online SPA whose category sections lazy-load their items only as each section scrolls into view - an in-app browser pane check first showed only 5 of 12 categories populated (Most popular/Coffee/Creative Drinks/Desserts/Frappe) with the remaining 7 appearing empty; confirmed via a real Chrome session with manual scroll-through that all 12 categories are in fact populated once scrolled into view (Fruit Tea, Matcha Series, Milk Tea Series, Pure Tea, Smoothies, Snacks, and Food Combo all rendered items after scrolling), so this was a lazy-load artifact, not missing menu data. Read all 12 sections and de-duplicated cross-listed items that repeat verbatim in multiple sections (e.g. 'Most popular' reprints 4 items already in their own category; A9/G5 reappear under Matcha Series; A11 reappears under Smoothies; Strawberry Matcha Milk reappears under Milk Tea Series) - each such dish counted once, filed under its primary category. Two items are both labeled 'F2.' by the restaurant itself (Vietnamese Ice Black Coffee $6.00 and Vietnamese Ice Milk Coffee $6.50) - kept both as separate real dishes since prices differ; likely a restaurant-side numbering typo, not a duplicate. Filed 97 unique dishes across Coffee(6), Creative Drinks(11), Desserts(3), Frappe(6), Fruit Tea(10), Matcha Series(8), Milk Tea Series(13), Pure Tea(9), Smoothies(11), Snacks(15), Food Combo(5).

name: Brothers Mexican Restaurant
notes: No independent restaurant website (batch file website field was null). Found the restaurant's own ordering platform (Clover) via Google search, matching address and phone exactly (3531 Adams Avenue, San Diego CA, (619) 228-9673). The Clover page currently shows 'isn't accepting online orders right now' but the full priced menu still renders - get_page_text returned the complete catalog cleanly in one pass across every category. 254 priced line items filed across Breakfast Plates, Breakfast Burritos, Signature Plates, Brother's Specials, Combination Plates, Burritos, Tacos, Chips, Fries, Starters, Salad, Taco Salad, Weekly Specials, Hamburgers, Chimichangas, Tostadas, Super Quesadillas, Super Tostadas, Tortas, Enchiladas, Seafood, Soups, Extras (priced add-ons, included as line items per playbook precedent), Sides, Drinks, and an 'Uncategorized' bucket for ~22 items (combo plates, breakfast specials, and beer/cocktail items) that the source page rendered without a category heading. Restaurant-side numbering repeats #2 three times in Breakfast Burritos and #1 three times in Combination Plates - kept as distinct dishes with their original labels rather than renumbered, consistent with how restaurants sometimes reuse menu numbers across their own physical menu boards. One 'Flan' line appeared twice in the source text (once priced $3.50, once with no price at all directly before the Drinks header) - treated as a duplicate/render artifact and filed only once at $3.50. All prices are clean figures, no scattered-cent pattern.
